_comment: Live addons used to playtest StreamioLink. Catalog = nuvio, sources = the four addons under test. The plugin accepts either the base URL or the manifest.json URL. Test movie: tt0111161 (The Shawshank Redemption).

sources.name: hdhub
sources.notes: Direct signed CDN links (R2 + pixeldrain). Fast and reliable.

sources.name: pengu
sources.notes: Aggregator; links are pengu.uk/direct/... 307 redirects to the same CDN objects hdhub returns (~8s redirect).

sources.name: cnc
sources.notes: CNCVerse Bridge. Many links; ~1/3 dead (404 / connection refused / HTML). Source-only (all catalogs are type other/tv).

sources.name: meteor
sources.notes: P2P torrent addon. This config blob is broken: languageFormat is an array, so /stream/* returns 401 'invalid session'. Regenerate with languageFormat as a string ("flags").
